_about: Every field of the intake record, whether a missing value blocks the review, the question to put to the proposer, and why the committee needs it. Read by scripts/check_completeness.py.

proposal_id.question: What is the proposal reference number?
proposal_id.why: Every review artefact and audit-log entry is keyed to it.

title.question: What is the short name of the proposal?

submitted_by.name.question: Who submitted the proposal?
submitted_by.name.why: Point of contact for follow-up questions.

submitted_by.role.question: What is the submitter's role?
submitted_by.role.why: Shows whether the business owner or a vendor drafted it.

accountable_executive.question: Which named executive will be accountable for this system's outcomes once live?
accountable_executive.why: Accountability cannot rest with a vendor or a committee; it needs a named owner.

organisation.name.question: Which legal entity will deploy the system?
organisation.name.why: Determines the data fiduciary under the DPDP Act.

organisation.sector.question: Is the employer a private company, a public sector undertaking or a government body?
organisation.sector.why: Public employers carry constitutional equality duties (Articles 14 and 16).

use_case.purpose.question: In one or two sentences, what decision will the AI support and why?
use_case.purpose.why: The committee approves a purpose, not a product.

use_case.problem_statement.question: What problem does the current process have that AI should solve, with figures if available?
use_case.problem_statement.why: Benefits must be weighed against risks; vague benefits weigh little.

use_case.expected_benefits.question: What measurable benefits do you expect (time saved, quality of hire, candidate experience)?
use_case.expected_benefits.why: Proportionality: a high-risk system needs a real, measured benefit.

use_case.alternatives_considered.question: What non-AI or lower-risk alternatives were considered, and why were they rejected?
use_case.alternatives_considered.why: Necessity: the least intrusive effective option should be preferred.

use_case.roles_in_scope.question: Which job roles and levels will the system screen?
use_case.roles_in_scope.why: Job-relatedness of every input can only be judged against specific roles.

use_case.annual_applications.question: Roughly how many applications per year will pass through the system?
use_case.annual_applications.why: Scale multiplies the number of people affected by any error or bias.

use_case.jurisdictions.question: In which countries or cities are the candidates located (e.g. IN, EU, US-NYC)?

system.vendor_name.question: Which vendor or internal team supplies the model?
system.vendor_name.why: Needed for due diligence and contract review.

system.build_type.question: Is the system bought from a third party, built in-house, or a hybrid?
system.build_type.why: Changes who holds the evidence and which contract terms are needed.

system.primary_function.question: What is the system's primary function (e.g. CV screening and ranking, assessment scoring, video interview analysis, interview scheduling)?
system.primary_function.why: Some functions are prohibited outright; others are high-risk.

system.decision_stage.question: At which stage of hiring does the AI act (sourcing, initial screening, assessment, interview, final selection, logistics)?
system.decision_stage.why: Earlier stages filter more people out before any human sees them.

system.automation_level.question: What happens to a candidate the AI scores low: shown to a recruiter, de-prioritised, auto-archived, or auto-rejected?
system.automation_level.why: The single most important risk driver: whether a human really decides.

system.ai_output.question: What exactly does the AI output: a score, a rank, a pass/fail flag, or a written summary?
system.ai_output.why: Determines what a reviewer sees and how much it anchors them.

system.techniques.video_or_facial_analys.question: Does any part of the system analyse video or faces?
system.techniques.video_or_facial_analys.why: Linked to emotion recognition and biometric risks.

system.techniques.emotion_or_affect_infe.question: Does any part of the system infer emotions, confidence, enthusiasm, honesty or personality from face, voice or behaviour?
system.techniques.emotion_or_affect_infe.why: Emotion recognition in the workplace is prohibited under EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(f) and is a red line in this organisation's policy.

system.techniques.voice_analysis.question: Does any part of the system analyse voice or accent?
system.techniques.voice_analysis.why: Accent is a strong proxy for region and mother tongue.

system.techniques.biometric_categorisati.question: Does the system categorise people by biometric data (e.g. inferring gender, age or ethnicity from images)?
system.techniques.biometric_categorisati.why: Biometric categorisation by protected traits is prohibited under EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(g).

system.techniques.social_media_screening.question: Does the system look at candidates' social media or other public online data?
system.techniques.social_media_screening.why: Purpose limitation, consent and proxy risks.

system.techniques.generative_llm_scoring.question: Does a large language model score, summarise or rank candidates?
system.techniques.generative_llm_scoring.why: LLM scores can vary run to run and can carry bias from name, language and writing style.

human_oversight.human_reviews_every_reje.question: Will a trained person look at every application before it is rejected?
human_oversight.human_reviews_every_reje.why: Without this, rejections are automated in practice.

human_oversight.human_reviews_every_judg.question: Where some rejections are automated, will a person review every rejection that rests on a judgment of ability (as opposed to a documented, verifiable hard requirement)?
human_oversight.human_reviews_every_judg.why: Automated rejection is defensible only for checkable facts; judgments about people need a person (policy POL-AI-03).

human_oversight.reviewer_can_override.question: Can recruiters override the AI ranking, and is that easy to do in the tool?
human_oversight.reviewer_can_override.why: Oversight without power to override is not oversight.

human_oversight.reviewers_trained.question: Will recruiters be trained on the system's limits and on automation bias?
human_oversight.reviewers_trained.why: EU AI Act Art. 26(2) requires competent, trained overseers; good practice everywhere.

human_oversight.overrides_logged.question: Will overrides and the reasons for them be logged?
human_oversight.overrides_logged.why: Override rates show whether humans are deciding or rubber-stamping.

human_oversight.ai_score_visible_before_.question: Do recruiters see the AI score before forming their own view of the candidate?
human_oversight.ai_score_visible_before_.why: Seeing the score first anchors judgment (automation bias).

data.input_features.question: List every input the model uses to score a candidate.
data.input_features.why: Each input is screened for protected attributes and proxies.

data.training_data.question: What data was the model trained on (whose data, which years, what labels)?
data.training_data.why: Training on past hiring decisions reproduces past bias.

data.trained_on_historical_hiring_outcom.question: Were the training labels the organisation's past hiring decisions?
data.trained_on_historical_hiring_outcom.why: The classic route by which historical discrimination is automated.

data.protected_attributes_collected_for_.question: Will candidates be invited to self-declare gender, age band, disability and region, voluntarily and separately from the model, for fairness auditing?
data.protected_attributes_collected_for_.why: Bias cannot be measured without group data; it must never feed the model.

data.lawful_basis.question: On what legal ground will candidate data be processed (consent or a specified legitimate use)?

data.notice_to_candidates.question: Will candidates receive an itemised privacy notice before their data is processed?

data.accuracy_controls.question: How will you ensure CV parsing and candidate data are complete and accurate before they are scored?
data.accuracy_controls.why: DPDP Act s. 8(3): data used for decisions about a person must be complete, accurate and consistent.

data.retention_days.question: How long will unsuccessful applicants' data be kept?
data.retention_days.why: Storage limitation; internal policy caps it at 180 days without fresh consent.

data.vendor_reuses_data_for_training.question: Will the vendor reuse candidate data to train or improve its own products?

data.cross_border_transfer.question: Will candidate data be stored or processed outside India?

data.transfer_destinations.question: If data leaves India, to which countries?
data.transfer_destinations.why: Transfers to countries restricted by government notification are not allowed.

transparency.candidate_notified_of_ai_us.question: Will candidates be told that AI is used in screening, and how?
transparency.candidate_notified_of_ai_us.why: Transparency and trust; required by EU AI Act Art. 26(11) and NYC Local Law 144 where they apply.

transparency.individual_explanations_ava.question: Can the system explain, for one candidate, the main reasons for their score?
transparency.individual_explanations_ava.why: Needed for contestability and for recruiters to exercise judgment.

transparency.model_documentation_availab.question: Has the vendor provided model documentation (intended use, limitations, validation results)?
transparency.model_documentation_availab.why: The committee cannot assess what it cannot see.

contestability.appeal_channel.question: Can a rejected candidate ask for a human re-review?
contestability.appeal_channel.why: People affected by consequential decisions need a route to challenge them.

contestability.human_alternative_on_requ.question: Can a candidate ask to be assessed without the AI (e.g. for disability-related reasons)?
contestability.human_alternative_on_requ.why: Reasonable accommodation under the RPwD Act, 2016.

contestability.grievance_officer_named.question: Is there a named grievance officer for candidate data and decision complaints?
contestability.grievance_officer_named.why: DPDP Act s. 8(10) requires an effective grievance mechanism.

testing.bias_audit_completed.question: Has a bias audit been completed on this system, on data like yours?
testing.bias_audit_completed.why: Evidence, not vendor assurance, is required.

testing.bias_audit_independent.question: Was the bias audit done by a party independent of the vendor?
testing.bias_audit_independent.why: Self-assessment by the seller is weak evidence.

testing.job_relatedness_validated.question: Has anyone shown that the scored inputs predict job performance in these roles?
testing.job_relatedness_validated.why: Inputs that do not predict performance can only add noise and bias.

testing.shadow_pilot_data_available.question: Do you have shadow-mode pilot data (AI outputs recorded but not used) with outcomes?
testing.shadow_pilot_data_available.why: Allows the committee to measure adverse impact before anyone is affected.

testing.accessibility_tested.question: Has the candidate journey been tested for accessibility (screen readers, time limits, alternatives)?
testing.accessibility_tested.why: RPwD Act, 2016: equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation.

monitoring.monitoring_plan.question: How will selection rates by group, override rates and errors be monitored after launch?
monitoring.monitoring_plan.why: Bias and drift appear after launch, not only before it.

monitoring.review_frequency_days.question: How often will monitoring results be reviewed, and by whom?
monitoring.review_frequency_days.why: A plan without a cadence is not a plan.

monitoring.kill_switch.question: Can the AI be switched off quickly with hiring continuing manually?
monitoring.kill_switch.why: Lets the organisation stop harm without stopping hiring.

monitoring.incident_process.question: What happens if a fairness or accuracy problem is found after launch?
monitoring.incident_process.why: Defines who acts, how fast, and who is told.

monitoring.runtime_guardian.question: Is there an independent runtime check that can block individual decisions and withdraw the system's autonomy automatically if outcomes become unfair?
monitoring.runtime_guardian.why: Approval is a point-in-time judgment; runtime controls catch drift and misconfiguration.

vendor_governance.allows_independent_aud.question: Will the vendor allow an independent auditor access to test the system?
vendor_governance.allows_independent_aud.why: A refusal is a red line: the system cannot be verified.

vendor_governance.model_change_notificat.question: Must the vendor notify you before changing the model?
vendor_governance.model_change_notificat.why: An approved system that silently changes is no longer the approved system.

vendor_governance.contract_has_dpdp_proc.question: Does the contract bind the vendor as a data processor under DPDP Act terms?
vendor_governance.contract_has_dpdp_proc.why: DPDP Act s. 8(2): processing only under a valid contract.

vendor_governance.security_assessment_do.question: Has information security assessed the vendor?
vendor_governance.security_assessment_do.why: DPDP Act s. 8(5): reasonable security safeguards.
